description: Delete a saved new-message draft from the Drafts folder. Returns a conflict while a send holds it, it waits in a scheduled send, or a person took it over in the inbox composer.

id.description: Mailbox ID that holds the draft.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

name: shipmail_delete_draft
title: Delete New Email Draft
